subscriptions.err_bill_rebilled.en: {ref} can't bill again. It was taken off {agreement} for {start} to {end}, and that period is now billed on {newer}. Issuing {ref} as well would bill the period twice.

subscriptions.err_bill_reopened.en: {ref} can't bill again. Its period on {agreement}, {start} to {end}, was reopened, so the next document for that period bills it. Use Generate due on the agreement to bill the period.

subscriptions.err_period_draft.en: The document for this period, {ref}, is back in draft. Finalize {ref} to bill the period, or use Reopen on its row in the periods list to bill it on a new document.

subscriptions.err_schedule_date.en: {day} is not a date Celerp can read. Enter it as a date.

subscriptions.err_schedule_frequency.en: Choose how often this agreement bills.

subscriptions.err_custom_interval.en: Enter a custom interval of 1 to 36500 days.

subscriptions.err_schedule_timing.en: Choose whether this agreement bills at the start or the end of each period.

subscriptions.err_term_before_first_peri.en: The term must end after the first billing period starts.

subscriptions.err_interval_calendar.en: This billing interval runs past the dates Celerp can count. Choose a shorter one.

subscriptions.not_moved_no_date.en: it has no next run date or start date

subscriptions.not_moved_custom_days.en: its custom interval "{days}" is not a number of days
